📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
Occurrence #170 overall — surfacing on the every-10th-occurrence rule (170 % 10 = 0). 24h suppression window has *not* elapsed (last DM 2026-06-16 14:18Z, ~20.8h ago), so this is a periodic visibility resurface, not a new escalation.

runtime-core-api RTC Screen Load p95 spike, *latency-only* (0 error logs). Peak 3.93s vs 3s threshold at 04:44:20Z (ratio 0.31, minor), cluster of 2.6–2.8s spikes 04:42–04:47Z, recovered to sub-second baseline within minutes. Monitor 115456700 last fired 04:49:20Z, now OK.

⚠️ Co-fire note: ki-21 frontend XHR storm fired ≥2 alerts in the same 04:00–05:00Z window → per the ki-24/ki-21 precedence note, treat as a shared-upstream signal (microservices.methodlocal.int / runtime-core RTC backpressure).

Playbook: 1) Confirm p95>3s cluster (done — 3.93s peak). 2) Confirm latency-only — error logs 0 (done). 3) *Diagnostic gap:* capture @duration:>3s traces in the spike window and find the dominant span (SQL / Mongo / Redis SCAN). 4) Mitigations: (a) raise threshold to 4s (cheap, masks — spikes stayed <4s this cycle), (b) per-resource circuit breaker, (c) profile slowest accounts + targeted index fixes (root cause).
